description: Deterministic signature fixture for the v0.5 `message` entry (§9.8) — the inter-agent mirror of §9.7, same key set. The Hub MUST reproduce header `v1` from JCS(message_signed_context) + HMAC-SHA256(test_key). `payload_sha256` is the lowercase-hex SHA-256 of JCS({"message": <content>}) where <content> carries exactly the delivered entry's PRESENT fields among type/title/body/priority/tags/context/request/action/sensitive (here: request, title, type) — `type` is bound because flipping notify/ask/task changes what the recipient does; `sensitive` is bound on this leg (unlike §9.7). Hub/transport metadata (id, from, to, created_at, expires_at) is excluded from the digest — from/id/to are bound as top-level signed fields — and the advisory `agent` descriptor and inert `idempotency_key` are excluded. The verifier MUST recompute the digest from the entry it received and rebuild the context from that entry (from/id/to) plus the header's t/jti. Matches examples/entry-signatures-v0.5.md §1.
obligation: Reproduce header `v1`; reproduce `payload_sha256` from the delivered entry's content fields (never trusting a transmitted digest — none is transmitted); reject a tampered from/to/payload (dp-012); reject a replayed `jti` within the window (cache TTL >= window) and a `t` outside +/-replay_window_seconds; re-sign every delivery with a fresh t/jti (dp-018). Expected runner wiring (#26): mirror the dp-005 branch with the §9.8 message context builder — build context, sign, compare v1 + canonical_jcs, recompute the content digest from `entry`.
